snippet.title: Medic: Pacific War - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Medic: Pacific War - you will become a true war hero. Survive the horror of the Pacific Front where bombs fall from the sky and rifle bullets cut the air. You are the last hope of your wounded companions. Your decisions will change the course of the battle, but not all of them will be easy to make.
